mapper.select: SELECT BOOKSET_ID AS id, BOOKSET_NAME AS text, BOOKSET_TYPE as col FROM BOK_BOOKSET

SELECT BS.SCENE_NODE_ID AS sceneNodeId,
CASE WHEN BS."LEVEL" <= #{level} then 1 ELSE 0 END as expanded,
1 as expanded,
CASE BS.NODE_ID WHEN 'ACCOUNTEVENTS' THEN 'ACCOUNTEVENTS' ELSE NVL(BTD1.DICT_CODE, BS.NODE_VALUE) END AS dictId, NVL(BTD1.DICT_NAME, #{bookEvent}) AS tableName, BS.NODE_VALUE AS nodeValue, BT.TABLE_NAME AS dictName, CASE WHEN COUNT(BSS.SCENE_NODE_ID) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isEntry, CASE WHEN COUNT(BS1.SCENE_NODE_ID) > 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isLeaf, BS.BOOKSET_ID AS booksetId, BS.UPDATE_TIME AS updateTime, CASE WHEN BS.FSCENE_NODEID IS NULL THEN 'root' ELSE BS.FSCENE_NODEID END fsceneNodeid, DECODE(BS.FSCENE_NODEID,NULL,2,'',2,0) AS disCbxCol, BS."LEVEL" AS "level" FROM BOK_SCENECONFIG BS LEFT JOIN BOK_TABLELIST BT ON BT.TABLE_ID = BS.NODE_VALUE and BS.NODE_ID = #{ACCOUNTEVENTS} AND BT.BOOKSET_ID = BS.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_TABLEDICT BTD1 ON BS.NODE_ID = BTD1.DICT_ID AND BTD1.DICT_TYPE = #{DICT_TYPEP} AND BTD1.BOOKSET_ID = BS.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_SCENESUBJECT BSS ON BS.SCENE_NODE_ID = BSS.SCENE_NODE_ID AND BSS.BOOKSET_ID = BS.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_SCENECONFIG BS1 ON BS1.FSCENE_NODEID = BS.SCENE_NODE_ID AND BS1.BOOKSET_ID = BS.BOOKSET_ID
GROUP BY BS.SCENE_NODE_ID, BTD1.DICT_CODE, BS.NODE_ID, BT.TABLE_NAME, BTD1.DICT_NAME, BS.NODE_VALUE, BS.BOOKSET_ID,BS.UPDATE_TIME,BS.FSCENE_NODEID,BS."LEVEL" ORDER BY BS.SCENE_NODE_ID
mapper.update: DELETE FROM BOK_SCENECONFIG WHERE SCENE_NODE_ID LIKE #{sceneNodeId}||'%'
UPDATE BOK_SCENESUBJECT SET UPDATE_TIME = #{updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, UPDATE_USER = #{updateUser} WHERE SCENE_NODE_ID LIKE #{sceneNodeId}||'%'
mapper.select: SELECT UPDATE_TIME FROM BOK_SCENECONFIG WHERE SCENE_NODE_ID = #{sceneNodeId}
